signature.name: VTask.toBlock
signature.type: {m : Type u_2} -> {n : Type u_3} -> {α : Type u_12} -> (M : Matrix m n α) -> (p : m → Prop) -> (q : n → Prop) -> Matrix { a // p a } { a // q a } α

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: toBlock is a total function with no junk-value conventions; it is well-defined for all matrices and all predicates, including vacuous ones.

facts.statement: example : (VTask.toBlock (fun i j : Fin 2 => if i = j then 1 else 0) (fun i => i = 0) (fun j => j = 0)) ⟨0, rfl⟩ ⟨0, rfl⟩ = 1 := by decide

M: fun i j : Fin 2 => if i = j then 1 else 0

facts.statement: example : (VTask.toBlock (fun i j : Fin 2 => if i = j then 1 else 0) (fun i => i = 0) (fun j => j = 1)) ⟨0, rfl⟩ ⟨1, rfl⟩ = 0 := by decide
